E3M1's 36 such pieces rise a median 8,192, 21 of them exactly that. Two-tier altars, biers and tombs rise 0.60-0.97 bodies (median 0.85; 42 pieces, 16 maps); a stall is a counter plus a lowered ceiling of the same footprint (66 pieces, 21 maps). What stands on them is face sprites (73 of E3M1's saloon's 77 sprites).
